name: math_abs
comment: Lua math library: abs(x)

name: math_sin
comment: Lua math library: sin(degrees); the argument is converted to radians (x * pi / 180)

name: math_cos
comment: Lua math library: cos(degrees)

name: math_tan
comment: Lua math library: tan(degrees)

name: math_asin
comment: Lua math library: asin(x) in degrees (CRT _CIasin, result * 180 / pi)

name: math_acos
comment: Lua math library: acos(x) in degrees (CRT _CIacos, result * 180 / pi)

name: math_atan
comment: Lua math library: atan(x) in degrees (fpatan(x, 1) * 180 / pi)

name: math_atan2
comment: Lua math library: atan2(y, x) in degrees

name: math_ceil
comment: Lua math library: ceil(x)

name: math_floor
comment: Lua math library: floor(x)

name: math_mod
comment: Lua math library: mod(x, y) = fmod

name: math_sqrt
comment: Lua math library: sqrt(x)

name: math_pow
comment: Lua math library: pow(x, y); also installed as the 'pow' tag method of numbers (the ^ operator)

name: math_log
comment: Lua math library: log(x), natural logarithm

name: math_log10
comment: Lua math library: log10(x)

name: math_exp
comment: Lua math library: exp(x)

name: math_deg
comment: Lua math library: deg(x), radians to degrees

name: math_rad
comment: Lua math library: rad(x), degrees to radians

name: math_min
comment: Lua math library: min(x, ...)

name: math_max
comment: Lua math library: max(x, ...)

name: math_random
comment: Lua math library: random() in [0,1) (rand() % 32767 / 32768), random(n) in [1,n]

name: math_randomseed
comment: Lua math library: randomseed(x), srand

name: _CIasin
comment: MSVC CRT: asin with the argument in ST(0) (was misnamed _CIsqrt)

name: _asin
comment: MSVC CRT: asin core (was misnamed _sqrt)

name: _CIacos
comment: MSVC CRT: acos with the argument in ST(0)

name: _acos
comment: MSVC CRT: acos core
